(ja)༄༅/ /rigs gsum mgon po'i sgrub thabs tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so/ /dpal stug kun gyi gsang gsum sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa dpa

tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// rigs gsum mgon po'i sgrub thabs tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so// dpal stug kun gyi gsang gsum sgyu ma'i 'phrul// mkhyen brtse nus pa dpag yas rigs gsum gyi// sems dpa'i tshul gyis 'gro ba 'dul ba por// gus pas btud de de yi sgrub thabs 'dri// rigs gsum gyi dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ de gsum gyi sgrub thabs nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ thog mar mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhal bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ nas shabda swā hā'i bar dang*/ dharmā ra ṇi sogs rol mo bcas bya'o// skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang rigs drug sems can deng nas bzung*// byang chub bar du rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// zhes pa lan gsum mam bdun gang rung dang*/ sems bskyed ni/ mar gyur 'gro rnams srid las bsgral ba'i phyir// bdag cag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya// de yi ched du 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon// bsgom bzlas rnal 'byor nyams su blang bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba rgyur bcas ldan// sdug bsngal kun 'byung bcas pa bral gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde la rtag gnas shing*// nye ring chags sdang med par gnas gyur cig /zhes tshad med bzhi bsgom/ ye shes tshogs bsags ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gyur zhes so// dngos gzhi la/

stong pa'i ngang las yi ge paṃ gsum las// padma'i gnas gsum a las zla gdan steng*// rang sems ngo bo dhīḥhrīḥhūm̐ gsum las// 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod cing 'gro don byas// tshur 'dus 'bru gsum yongs su gyur pa las// bdag nyid rigs gsum mgon por gyur pa ni// dbus su 'jam dpal btso ma gser gyi mdog /phyag g.yas shes rab ral gri mkhar phyar zhing*// g.yon pas utpal sdong bu thugs kar bzung*// 'dab stong snyan thad gyes steng po ti bsnams// lang tsho bcu drug lor gnas 'dzum sgeg nyams// ral pa'i cod pan zur phud lnga dang ldan// mi phyed zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dbang ston zla'i mdangs// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gcig shos padma dkar// zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang ba'i rol stabs bzhugs// g.yon du phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngo// phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kar dang*// g.yon pas dril bu dkur brten 'gying bag nyams// zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// gsum ga'ang mtshan dang dpe byad lham mer gsal// sna tshogs dar gyi stod g.yogs smad sham bklubs// rin chen rgyan phreng brgyad kyi sku la brgyan// snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can gyur// de nas thal mo gnyis sbyar ba las mdzub mo gnyis cung zad bkug pa mgo bor reg cing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga to bha wā ya swā hā/ thal mo sbyar ba padma kha phye ba'i tshul du byas pas snying gar reg cing*/ oṃ padmodbha wā ya swā hā/ thal mo gnyis rgyab sbyar la mthe bong mthe'u chung gnyis sbyar nas lte bar reg cing*/ oṃ badzrodbha wā ya swā hā/ zhes rigs gsum gyi dam tshig gi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlab bo// lha de gsum gyi spyi bor rnam snang dang*// snang ba mtha' yas mi bskyod pa yis brgyan// rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer gyis// rang bzhin lhun grub gnas nas rigs gsum mgon// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas yongs bskor ba// skad cig spyan drangs badzra sa mā dzaḥ

/mdun gyi nam mkhar brtan par bzhugs shig /bkra shis padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin brlabs pas// mchod yul dgyes pa'i nyer spyod gya nom pa// mchod yul me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo mchod pa'i sprin chen 'di// rgyal ba kun dngos rigs gsum lha tshogs la// 'bul gyis bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā de bzhin du/ oṃ badzra puṣpaṃ/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shabda pra tītstsha swā hā zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ bstod pa ni/ bde gshegs kun gyi sku gsung thugs gsang ba// bsam mi khyab bdag mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter// 'jam dbyangs 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /'gro ba'i re skong rigs gsum mgon la bstod// sku gsung thugs 'jam 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal// gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin yon tan rgyas pa'i sku/ de phyir 'jam dpal gzhon nur mtshan gsol ba// blo gros bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i ye shes sku// 'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal// gzi brjid 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas// rig sngags gsang sngags kun gyi bdag po ste// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa// bcom ldan rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ces pas bstod/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ bdag mdun lha gsum gsal ba'i thugs ka'i zlar// dhīḥhrīḥhūm̐ gi sa bon gsum gyi mthar// rang rang sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gsal// mdun bskyed thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng las// 'od zer sngags phreng rnam pa phyogs bcur 'phros// rgyal ba rgyal sras nyan rang grub pa dang*// lha klu drang srong kun gyi mkhyen brtse mthu// ji snyed tshur bsdus rang gi thugs kar thim// de dag kun gyi byin rlabs nus pa yi// dngos grub thams cad rgyud la zhugs par bsam// oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ

gtso bor bzla/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ dang*/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ zhes pa gnyis kyang ci nus bzlas mthar mchod yon me tog sogs nas shabda pra tītstsha'i bar dang*/ bde gshegs kun gyi sku gsung thugs gsang ba/ bsam mi khyab bdag mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter// 'jam dbyangs 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /'gro ba'i re skong rigs gsum mgon la bstod// zhes dang*/ bcom ldan bdag dang sems can thams cad la// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes 'dod don zhus la/ mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor nyams pa dang*// bdag blo rmongs pas ting 'dzin mi gsal sogs// thugs dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa ci bgyis pa// rigs gsum lha tshogs bzod par mdzad du gsol// zhes nongs pa bshags nas/ mdun bskyed rang bzhin gnas su badzra muḥ /zhes pa'i gshegs gsol dang*/ snying ga'i dhīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pa'i mod// 'khor gnyis gdan bcas 'od zhu rang la thim// rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa'i 'jam dpal gyur// gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ dkar gtor chab kyis bran te/ rdo rje bsnams pa 'debs pa'i tshul dang*/ oṃ a kā ru mu khaṃ sarba dha rmā ṇāṃ adya nutpanan twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ bdag nyid 'jam dpal thugs ka'i sa bon gyis// rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams nas// 'jam dbyangs 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /'khor bcas 'dir spyon badzra sa mā dzaḥ /zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ ljags las 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas gtor ma gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ a ra pa tsa sogs sngags gsum gyi mthar oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la bstod pa gong bzhin shlau ka gcig dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod don zhus/ de nas sa bdag sogs dngos gzhi gang yin pa ltar gyer la/

mthar bsdu ba'i tshe gtor mgron la mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor sogs gong bzhin brjod pas gshegs su gsol ba dang*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rigs gsum mgon po 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces sogs bsngo ba smon lam gang shes dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// dngos grub sgrub thabs srid pa'i so nam min// tshogs gsum bsgrigs legs gzhan 'drid kha gsags min// don gnyer re bskong khe grags bsgrub phyir min// gang phyir tshul 'dir 'bad la mi spro med// lhag pa'i lha mchog gsum gyi sgrub pa'i thabs// rgyud dang mkhas pa'i gzhung mthun byas pa yin// dge bas sems can khams la bde skyid kyi// kun phan 'od kyi bdud rtsi 'thung bar shog /ces rigs gsum mgon po'i sgrub thabs nyung gsal 'di'ang padma phun tshogs kyi ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa'o// ༈ //rmad byung mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od stong gis// mi shes sgrib pa'i sngo bsangs ring bsal nas// blo gros 'dab stong phye ba dkon mchog gsum// dbyer med dpal ldan bla mas rtag tu srungs// 'di na rnam 'dren bstan pa'i rjes zhugs nas// legs pa'i lam la slob 'dod bshes gnyen nas// 'di phyir phan pa'i gdams pa dgos gsungs pa// mdor bsdus ngag gi gleng ba 'di skad mol// khams gsum 'khor ba gang du skyes gyur kyang*// sdug bsngal de rgyu mi dge bcu dag gi /thar dus med pa'i btson ra ltar shes nas// srid las nges par 'byung ba'i blo bskyed 'tshal// 'gro drug khrod nas dam chos sgrub pa'i rten// dal 'byor mi lus mtshungs pa gzhan la med// de nyid lan mang thob pa'i skabs med pas// da lam snying po blang ba'i thabs la 'bungs// zag bcas rten 'di mi rtag 'jig chos su// ma song rang dbang bsdad pa su zhig yod// de tshul rang la 'byung ba'i tshul shes nas// bag med g.yeng ba'i lam du mi btang ces// dge sdig las kyi 'bras bu mi bslu ba// byed po rang las gzhan la mi smin phyir// sdig spang dge ba ci nus sgrub pa dang*// yang dag lta bas dal 'byor don yod mdzod// theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba rang nyid la// gces pa bor nas tshe rabs du ma nas// pha mar byas pa'i dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gror// tshad med byams dang snying rje bsgom pa gces// snying rje'i yul gyur de rnams sdug bsngal las// bsgral nas bde ba'i go sar 'god dgos kyang*// de mthu sangs rgyas min pa su la yod// de phyir sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam la 'jug

/lam yang pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags gnyis// phyi ma thabs la mkhas shing myur lam ste// sngags la rtsa ba dbang bskur thob nas ni// rtsa ba yang dag dam tshig bsrung ba gnad// lam gyi gtso bo rnal 'byor bla med kyi// yab chos kye rdor bde mchog 'jigs byed dam// nā ro mkha' spyod spyan ras gzigs dmar khrid// gang rung thugs dam gtsor byas don chen 'grub// kun gyi thog ma bla ma dkon mchog gsum// bdag gzhan byang chub bar du skyabs song na// lam log 'jigs pa kun las skyob byed pa'i// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab// de nas gzhan don sangs rgyas thob phyir du// lam bzang sgrub la 'jug pa'i sems bskyed bya// sgrib sbyang rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas dang*// bsod nams tshogs bsags rang rang gzhung bzhin du// ci nus bsgrub pas mi dge'i las sbyangs shing*// bskyed rim sangs rgyas gzugs sku 'grub pa'i rgyu// de rjes phyi nang snod bcud 'khor 'das chos// thams cad rang sems kho na'i cho 'phrul te// rmi lam yul gyi ltad mo ji bzhin du// sems nyid de der snang las gzhan ma yin// sems kyang brtags na gcig dang du ma med// kha dog dbyibs sam skye 'gag gnas pa bral// yod med la sogs mtha' bral stong pa nyid// shes pa ye shes tshogs bsags 'chi ba'i srid// sbyong byed chos sku 'grub pa'i rgyu yin te// tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i dgos pa yod// stong nyid de yi rang gdangs ma 'gags rtsal// gzhal yas khang ngam pad zla gang yin steng*// rang rang gzhung mthun lha sku zhal phyag gi /rnam pa sgyu ma lta bu'i snang stong bsgom// des ni snod kyi 'jig rten chags dang bcud// sems can skye ba sbyang ba'i bskyed rim mo// de la brten pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa yang*// gzhung bzhin bsgom pas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug 'gyur// dngos grub sgrub thabs gtso bo bzlas pa ni// bde gshegs kun la snyan gsan 'bebs pa ste// khyad par rtsa sngags nye snying snying po yis// lha yi sku gsung thugs rgyud bskul ba'i sngags// bzlas tshul sngags kyi rang sgra grag tsam la// rang bzhin skye 'gag bral ba'i grag stong ngang*// bzlas pas srid pa gsum gyi sgra dbyangs sbyong*// sangs rgyas chos 'khor bskor ba lam du byed// sems la re zhig ldog cha gsum dbye na// mtshan nyid gsal ba lha sku gzugs rnam can// rang bzhin stong pa chos sku ngo bo nyid// zung 'jug longs sku bsgom bya sgom byed las// 'das pa ngo bo nyid sku'i rang bzhin du// gnyis su med pa lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas// nges shes bskyed kyin nyams su blang bya'o// snod bcud lha yi 'khor lo 'od gsal klong*// bsdus nas dmigs med dbyings su bzhag pa yis// snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig dang bcud sems can// 'chi ba sbyong zhing chos sku lam byed do// gzhan yang thun mtshams spyod lam thams cad du// rang dang snang ba snang stong lha yi sku// sgra skad thams cad grag stong sngags kyi gsung*// dran rtog rig stong dbyer med lha yi thugs// ma yengs rtag tu dran shes bstan byas na// 'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad du// phan par nges pa'i gdams pa sngags spyod la// mkhas dang grub pa'i gsung don mdo tsam mo// rgyas pa gang du smos pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi// rnam bshad khrid gzhung gang la gtsor bton pa'i// de ga'i gzhung la thos bsam bgyid pa las// 'di na yi ger 'dri bas ga la ldang*// de skad mdo rgyud padma'i dga' tshal las// nyams len snying po sbrang rtsi mngar ba'i bcud// bdag blo bung bas btus pa'i khud pa 'di// bla med byang chub sgrub pa'i gsos su longs// 'di bgyis rnam dkar dge bas mar gyur 'gro// rnam 'dren bstan pa dam pa'i rjes zhugs nas// thos bsam bsgom pa gegs med pha rol son// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/ces nyams su blang bya'i gdams pa sbrang rtsi'i bcud len zhes bya ba 'di ni/ nya brag dgon gyi bla ma byams pa mkhyen rab pa'i ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas la gor gdams pa sarbārtha siddhaṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// mngon 'dod lam dang mthun pa'i smon lam don yod zhags pa zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// sarba pra ṇi dhi siddhaṃ bha wa tu/ nam mkhar bla ma phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*// rgyal sras nyan thos rang rgyal srung ma'i tshogs// sprin ltar gtibs pa'i spyan sngar bdag gi lus// grangs med btud pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// me tog sogs kyis mchod nas sdig ltung bshags// dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol sgo gsum gyi// dge tshogs bla med byang chub thob phyir bsngo// bdag gis 'gro rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral phyir// tshogs gnyis mthar phyin sangs rgyas thob par shog /de nyid mngon gyur bar gyi skye nas skyer// mi khom brgyad du skye bar ma gyur cig /dal 'byor lus thob dam pas rjes bzung nas// skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum dang mi 'bral zhing*// sdig spong dge ba sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// 'jig rten yang dag lta la spyod gyur cig /rgyal bstan rtsa ba so thar sdom pa dang*// bstan pa'i snying po byang sems sdom par ldan// yang snying sngags kyi sdom pa rim gyis sam// cig car thob pa'i skal ldan bdag gyur cig /de dag so so'i zab mo lta ba'i gzhung*// rgya chen spyod pa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams dang*// sgom pa nyams len rim pa'i gzhung rnams la// thos bsam bsgom byung blo gros rgyas par shog /bslab bya gzhan la gnod pa gzhir bcas sogs// nyes spyod bsdam zhing dge chos sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum bsrung zhing*// phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i lam la 'jug par shog

/rnam rtog mtshan mas dben pa'i zhi gnas dang*// bdag med gnas lugs rtogs pa'i lhag mthong gnyis// mi 'bral zung du 'brel ba'i rnal 'byor gyis// chos kun bdag med gnas lugs rtogs par shog /zab gsal bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis// snang srid 'khrul pa'i snang ba ji snyed pa// rnam dag sku dang ye shes 'khor lor 'char// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug gom pa'i stabs// ci yang bsgyur la mkhas pa'i rnal 'byor pas// lam lnga sa bcu'i thig pa rim bgrod de// yon tan bsam mi khyab par dbang 'byor shog /de lta'i lam mchog sgrub la phyi nang gi /bar chad 'phreng gegs mun pa 'thibs gyur na// skyabs gsum thugs rje'i 'od brgyas drungs phyung nas// bde legs phan bde'i 'dab stong grol bar shog /ces skye nas skye bar mngon 'dod lam dang mthun pa'i smon lam don yod zhags pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ri khrod pa bkra shis dbang phyug gis bskul ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas 'phral du bris pa smon pa'i 'bras bu thams cad smin par gyur cig// / ༄// dgos skabs kyi 'dod gsol bzhugs so// ༄༅// de mtshams gang la skyabs su song tsam srid dang zhi'i// 'jigs pa kun las bskyabs nas ci 'dod dpal// bde blag phyin pa dkon mchog rnam gsum dang*// thugs rje myur ma rje btsun sgrol ma kye// chos don gnyer dang tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong phyir// bdag sogs mi dang rta phyugs 'khor dang bcas// bshul ring lam du yar 'gro mar 'ong dang*// gang du sdod pa'i gnas skabs thams cad du// 'go bar 'gyur ba'i chu bur nad yams dang*// gdon bgegs gnod pas mi tshugs rtag bsrung zhing*// dgra rkun gcan gzan chu bo'i 'jigs pa sogs// mi 'byung bsrung ba'i skyabs sbyin phyag rkyongs shig /bsod nams ri bo brling ba'i ngos yangs nas// 'chi med tshe yi gaṅgā'i rgyun ring 'bab// gzhung lugs thos bsam sgom pa'i blo rgyas nas// chos la mkhas pa'i byed po nyid byin rlobs// sangs rgyas sku gsum sogs nas/

ji ltar gsol btab snye ma g.yur za mdzod// ces gnas skabs kyi 'dod don gsol gdab 'di'ang*/ dbon bkra shis nor bu dbus la bteg skabs rgyun du 'don bya rgyur/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis rma rong chab tshan khar bris pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
